msg: RULING ADR 0026 write side (P3 widened), after P6f re-timed here (dead remote: 5.5 s once, then 162/181 ms; suite 13/183-1skip/87 green -> P6 may land after the critic). Write-side hang confirmed on main: one emit still running at 20 s, AND no local tic or commit existed when killed — _tic_git_open fetches BEFORE the write, so a killed emit LOSES the tic. ORDER: (1) bound the write path now (liveness+loss bug on main, hits agents too), (2) hook-local amendment next, (3) dogfood config last. DESIGN = (a) + shared attempt stamp, NOT (b): detached pushes outlive the session and race emits on one checkout. Rules: write+commit locally BEFORE any network (open = local init/orphan, no fetch); every network call under a watchdog (TICS_NET_TIMEOUT default 5 s, kill the process group; no timeout(1) on macOS); retry only on a non-fast-forward rejection, never on timeout/network error; on network failure set the shared attempt stamp and return 0; within TTL after a failed attempt emits skip the network; tics sync publishes. Red with a deterministic hang, no real network: remote ssh://hang/x.git + GIT_SSH_COMMAND='sleep 600'. Assert: emit < ~10 s, exit 0, tic committed locally; 2nd emit in TTL < 1 s with no ssh spawned; sync after restore publishes both; P1 stays green.
